newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George reduces computer centres.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George reduces computer centres.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it has rationalised its computer centres in New South Wales and South Australia from six to two, which would save between A$6 million and A$8 million in future operating costs.

The rationalisation follows the recent takeover by St George of Advance Bank Australia Ltd. The change would result in a reduction of an estimated 28 positions within its unit Bank SA over the next 12 months.
St George said staff in these positions would be offered, where possible, redeployment with Bank SA or the overall group, but it was expected there will be some retrenchments.

St George said it has also appointed Kerry Gilbert as chief general manager of commercial banking, Anne Ellison as chief general manager human resources and John Loebenstein chief general manager information technology.
